kebab_example: aliyun rocketmq list-instance-inspection-runs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id rmq-cn-example --api-version 2022-08-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstanceInspectionRuns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. Wildcards are not allowed
parameters.help_zh: 所属实例 ID；不允许通配符
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the inspection item
parameters.name: template_code

parameters.help_en: The start time for filtering by execution request time. The value is inclusive and must be in ISO 8601 format with a time zone
parameters.help_zh: 按执行请求时间筛选的起始时间，含边界；带时区 ISO 8601
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for filtering by execution request time. The value is inclusive, must be later than startTime, and must be in ISO 8601 format with a time zone
parameters.help_zh: 按执行请求时间筛选的截止时间，含边界；须晚于 startTime；带时区 ISO 8601
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The execution status of the instance task for filtering. Valid values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, PartiallySucceeded, and Failed
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The inspection result for filtering. If templateCode is specified, this parameter filters the result of the specific item. Otherwise, it filters the result of the instance report
parameters.help_zh: 巡检结论筛选；传 templateCode 时筛选该项结论，否则筛选实例报告结论
parameters.name: result

parameters.help_en: The report processing status for filtering. Filtering is applied before pagination. Valid values: NotRequired (no AI processing required), Pending (waiting for processing), Running (processing), Succeeded (processed successfully), Failed (processing failed), and Expired (the content has expired). Whether the content is viewable is determined by reportAvailable
parameters.help_zh: 按报告处理状态筛选，先过滤再分页；NotRequired 无需 AI 处理，Pending 等待处理，Running 处理中，Succeeded 处理成功，Failed 处理失败，Expired 正文已过期；正文是否可查看以 reportAvailable 为准
parameters.name: report_status

parameters.help_en: The field used to sort results in descending order. Default value: requestedAt, which sorts by execution time. You can also set this parameter to reportFinishedAt to sort by report completion time, but you must also filter by reportStatus=Succeeded. If the time is the same, results are sorted in descending order by taskId
parameters.help_zh: 倒序排序字段；默认 requestedAt 按执行时间；reportFinishedAt 按报告完成时间且必须同时筛选 reportStatus=Succeeded；同时间按 taskId 倒序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query. When querying the next page, keep all filtering conditions consistent
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的游标；首次查询不传；翻页须保持所有筛选条件一致
parameters.name: next_token

data.description_en: The historical inspection records on the current page

aiSummary.descriptionEn: Script-generated summary for normal results, LLM-generated summary for risks; includes generation status and successful output.
aiSummary.description_en: The AI one-sentence summary. Normal results are summarized by scripts, and risk results are summarized by large language models (LLMs). This field includes the generation status and the original text upon success, and is empty if the summary is not generated
aiSummary.description_zh: 正常结果由脚本总结，风险结果由 LLM 总结；包含生成状态及成功后的原文，未生成时为空

status.description_en:
The summary generation status. Valid values:
Pending: Waiting.
Running: Generating.
Succeeded: Generated.
Failed: Generation failed.
This status does not change the inspection result
status.description_zh: Pending 等待、Running 生成中、Succeeded 已生成、Failed 生成失败；不改变巡检结果

text.description_en: The result summary. This field is returned only when the generation succeeds. It contains up to 200 characters and is not concatenated or truncated by the frontend
text.description_zh: 仅生成成功时返回，最多 200 字，不由前端拼接或截取
text.example: 本次巡检未发现风险，实例运行正常。

additionalProperties.descriptionEn: Number of resources flagged by the script. A complete scan without risk hits returns 0. Items that are pending, failed or missing count evidence omit the key; consult item status. AI analysis does not change this count.
additionalProperties.description_en: The risk resource count determined by scripts for this inspection item. The value is 0 if a full scan finds no hits. Keys are not returned for items that are incomplete, failed, or lack statistical evidence. Evaluate this field in combination with the status of each item. AI does not modify this count
additionalProperties.description_zh: 该巡检项由脚本判定的风险资源数量。完整扫描未命中为 0；未完成、失败或缺少统计证据的项目不返回键，结合逐项状态判断。AI 不修改此计数

findingCounts.description_en: The number of risk resources determined by scripts, counted by inspection item code. AI does not modify this count. The value is 0 if a full scan finds no hits. Keys are not returned for items that are incomplete, failed, or lack statistical evidence. Evaluate this field in combination with the status of each item
findingCounts.description_zh: 按巡检项编码统计脚本判定的风险资源数，AI 不修改计数；完整扫描未命中为 0，未完成、失败或缺少统计证据的项目不返回键，结合逐项状态判断
